title: Field Gauge Overpressure Alert — RS-22

lines.text: Field, this is Supervisor Oyelowo. Tech Jones at RS-22 confirms 30 in. w.c. on the field gauge. PR-7B is showing 15 in. w.c. and rising, and PR-7A is offline. The pilot regulator at RS-22 is cycling rapidly and not holding pressure. We need to report this as a potential overpressure condition.

fields.voiceStyle: Middle-aged male, calm but urgent, slightly out of breath

instructorNote: This inject confirms the overpressure condition on the ground. The field team has validated the SCADA discrepancy. Watch for whether the FOS reports to the GCM and IC, and whether they attempt manual isolation without authorization.
